# Harness box v3: ngspice pilot predictions

**Predictions from an idealised model, not measurements. No FMEDA credit.** Each row names the bench case whose pass criterion it informs. Model limits and the reasons are in the [README](README.md).

## 1. Clamp diode faults (D2 on CAN0, D3 on CAN2)

Differential at the far receiver of the faulted bus: in pass-through the other end of the joined bus, in intercept the device. ISO 11898-2 receiver: recessive below 0.5 V, dominant above 0.9 V, each line within -2 ... +7 V of ground.

## 2. Camera-bus termination in intercept

Camera sends one dominant bit to the device. Dominant level at the device, and the time from the end of the bit until the differential falls below 0.5 V. A time beyond about 1 us (sample point 1.5 us of a 2 us bit, edge already 0.5 us late) puts the next bit at risk.

| Case | Dominant (V) | Recessive edge (us) | Prediction | For |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Nominal: R7 and R8 through the P13-P15 loopback (60 ohm) | 2.57 | 0.0314 | levels OK | VS-HW-24 (c) |
| Loopback P13-P15 open in the plug (R7 only, 120 ohm) | 3 | 0.0552 | levels OK | VS-HW-24 (c) |
| R7 open (R8 only, 120 ohm) | 3 | 0.0552 | levels OK | VS-HW-24 (c) |
| R7 open and loopback open (camera bus unterminated in intercept) | 3.99 | 10.5 | recessive edge too slow for the sample point | VS-HW-24 (c) |
| Assumption variant: camera has its own 120 ohm (40 ohm in intercept) | 2.03 | 0.0159 | levels OK | VS-HW-24 (c) |

## Parameters

| Name | Value | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `VIN` | 13.2 V | box VIN: 13.5 V ignition less the D1 drop |
| `R_ON` | 30 ohm | closed switch channel; swept 10 to 100 ohm in the signal-integrity cases; DG419LE value unconfirmed (DFM-ACT-015) |
| `R_OFF` | 1e+09 ohm | open switch channel |
| `VDOM_H` | 4.5 V | transmitter CAN_H source when dominant |
| `VDOM_L` | 0.5 V | transmitter CAN_L source when dominant |
| `R_OUT` | 25 ohm | transmitter output resistance per line; with the two above gives about 2.2 V on a 60 ohm bus, inside ISO 11898-2's 1.5-3.0 V |
| `V_REC` | 2.5 V | recessive bias of each transceiver |
| `R_IN` | 25000 ohm | receiver input resistance per line to the recessive bias |
| `R_CAR` | 60 ohm | car side of the camera bus: both ends lumped (the Toyota A loopback gives the camera side 60 ohm in intercept, so the car side is taken as terminated by the car) |
| `C_LINE` | 2e-10 F | capacitance of each line to ground per bus segment (cable, connectors, transceiver pins) |
| `BIT` | 2e-06 s | bit time at 500 kbit/s |
| `SAMPLE` | 1.5e-06 s | sample point, 75 % of the bit |
| `I_LEAK` | 1e-06 A | net leakage into the U1/U2 IN node, sign unknown |

Diode model: `.model dsch d(is=1e-8 n=1.05 rs=1 cjo=5p)` (generic small-signal Schottky, not the BAS40SDW vendor model).
